sources.protocol: 02_rev2 §4 (factors, severity grid {0,0.125,...,1}, perturb_seed, claim limits: radius_max 7 px, JPEG quality_min 18, zoom_out_max 2.4)
sources.plan: 03_rev1 §4/§6/§10 and 03_rev2 §8/§14 (msim ops with explicit rng; scale_v1 with mask geometry; severity-0 identity; two-process determinism)
sources.legacy: code/msim/simulator.py (read-only) - parameter defaults and formulas reused

pipeline: cached 256x256 uint8 RGB -> perturb.apply -> preprocess.to_model_input (INTER_LINEAR 224, /255, ImageNet norm). Masks: mask_interp_v1 -> mask_to_cache_grid (INTER_NEAREST_EXACT 256) -> apply -> INTER_NEAREST_EXACT 224

severity.zero: identity for every factor; JPEG bypass (no re-encode)

rng.retrospective: all random draws of a factor are unconditional and in fixed order so every severity shares one realization (legacy skipped glare draw at intensity<0.01; legacy seeded via Python hash of content)

blur.formula: r=7*s; r<0.3 identity; cv2.GaussianBlur(k=2*round(3r)+1, sigma=r, BORDER_REPLICATE)

illumination.formula: sign=+1 if rng.random()<0.5 else -1; bright=0.28*s*sign; contrast=1-0.25*s*sign; temp=0.22*s*sign; x=(img/255-0.5)*contrast+0.5+bright; R*=(1+temp); B*=(1-temp); clip(x*255,0,255).astype(uint8)

compression.formula: q=round(95+(18-95)*s); cv2.imencode('.jpg', BGR, IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY=q) -> imdecode; OpenCV default sampling

scale.formula: z=1+1.4*s; off=0.18*s; inset=INTER_AREA resize to (int(256/z)); centre +/- rng offset direction*off*256 (clipped); legacy synthetic low-frequency skin-tone surround (rng noise, sigma 0.06*256) ; feathered alpha (inner 10%, Gaussian)
scale.mask: same inset geometry, INTER_NEAREST_EXACT, zero fill (scale_v1); feathered image border vs hard mask border documented

nuisance.formula: glare: ellipse axes (0.14W,0.10H), random centre/angle, Gaussian 0.035*256, intensity 0.95*s; hair: round(16*s) of 16 pre-drawn strands, alpha 0.30-0.65, colour (35,28,24)

ham_all_white_masks: ISIC_0026042 / ISIC_0029819 flags preserved (Addendum A3); not repaired
claim: controlled synthetic image changes; not calibrated to or reproducing real smartphone acquisition
